0022600018.text: The Knicks (2-3, eighth in the East and two games back in the Atlantic, riding a two-game win streak) visit the 76ers (4-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East, on a one-game win streak) in the Knicks' sixth game of the 2026-27 season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), Jaylen Brown (knee), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain). The Knicks trail the season series 0-1 after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20, the 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, and New York won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0.
